name: Yuki-onna
desc: A hauntingly beautiful spirit born from mountain blizzards. Clad in a translucent white kimono, she wanders frozen peaks, luring weary travelers into snowdrifts to drain their vital heat with an icy breath.

movements.custom: Floats effortlessly over deep snow without leaving footprints.

weakness: Exposing the Yuki-onna to boiling water, intense radiant heat, or forcing her to break a sworn secret causes her physical manifestation to instantly melt into mist.

actions.name: Freezing Gale
actions.desc: Yuki-onna exhales a freezing cone of arctic wind. Creatures in the area must roll against {ATK} or take cold damage and become heavily restrained by rime ice.

actions.name: Life-Draining Kiss
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: {ATK} to hit a willing, incapacitated, or charmed creature. Deals massive cold damage, draining the victim's vital warmth and healing Yuki-onna for the same amount.

actions.name: Seductive Glare
actions.desc: Yuki-onna fixes her piercing gaze on a mortal within 60 feet. The target must defend against {ATK} or become charmed, walking helplessly towards her.

actions.name: Snowfall Dissolution
actions.desc: When targeted by a physical attack, Yuki-onna uses {DEF} to dissolve into a cloud of swirling snowflakes, mitigating damage and reforming up to 20 feet away.
